metrics.label: Challenge WPA
metrics.definition: Sum of Win Probability Added across all successful ABS challenges for a team or player.
metrics.formula: Σ delta_home_win_exp for overturned pitches (adjusted for team perspective)
caveats: WPA is context-dependent — a challenge in a blowout contributes nearly zero.
Based on Statcast WPA model, which may differ from ESPN or Baseball Reference.
Small samples (< 5 successful challenges) are highly volatile.

metrics.label: Challenge Success Rate
metrics.definition: Proportion of ABS challenges that resulted in an overturned call.
caveats: Does not weight by leverage — a meaningless challenge counts the same as a game-changing one.
Samples below 10 challenges are flagged as unreliable.

metrics.label: Net Overturns
metrics.definition: Overturns in a team's favor minus overturns against them.
caveats: Does not capture leverage — a team can have positive net overturns but negative WPA.

metrics.label: Challenge Usage Rate
metrics.definition: Challenges used per available challenge opportunity.
caveats: Total opportunities is estimated (2 per game per team) — actual availability varies.

metrics.label: Expected Win%
metrics.definition: Pythagorean win expectancy based on runs scored and allowed.
caveats: Exponent 1.83 is the MLB-calibrated Pythagorean exponent (James, 1980).
Deviations from actual W% suggest luck or bullpen performance.
